emailTemplates.body:
Dear {{candidateName}},

Thank you for your time and effort throughout the interview process for the {{positionTitle}} position at {{companyName}}.

After thorough consideration, we have decided to proceed with another candidate for this role. This was a difficult decision, as we were impressed by your qualifications and the conversations we had.

Best regards,
{{hrName}}
{{companyName}} Talent Acquisition Team
